 Real Madrid are set for a highly anticipated clash against Germany’s RB Leipzig this Wednesday evening, as part of the third round of the league phase in the 2026-2027 UEFA Champions League. In this encounter, the Spanish giants will be looking to continue their European campaign with a positive result.
 The Santiago Bernabéu Stadium will host the clash between Real Madrid and RB Leipzig. There is much anticipation regarding the selections of the Spanish side’s manager, Portuguese coach José Mourinho, given the presence of several absentees and the possibility of changes to the starting lineup.
 During the pre-match press conference, Mourinho confirmed that the Brazilian Vinícius Júnior would start the game. However, he did not clarify the status of player Yann Diomandé when asked about his expected role in the encounter.
 The Portuguese coach has deployed Fede Valverde as a full-back in the last two matches. He has also praised the player’s performance on several occasions, which suggests that Valverde could continue in this position against the German side.
 Real Madrid’s squad saw the return of Brazilian defender Eder Militao after recovering from injury. He featured in the last match against Sevilla in La Liga.
 Meanwhile, Rodrygo, Ferland Mendy, and Raúl Asensio remain sidelined as they continue their recovery programs. At the same time, Mourinho may opt to rest some key players in preparation for the highly anticipated Clásico against Barcelona in La Liga, scheduled for next Sunday.
 Real Madrid’s predicted lineup against Leipzig
 Goalkeeper: Thibaut Courtois.
 Defense: Trent Alexander-Arnold, Ibrahima Konaté, Dean Huijsen, Marc Cucurella.
 Midfield: Fede Valverde, Jude Bellingham, Aurélien Tchouaméni, Arda Güler.
 Attack: Vinícius Júnior, Kylian Mbappé.
